bio:
Daniel (1796-1838) married Martha Lum/Linn.

FamilySearch gives Daniel a birth date of 28 Nov 1796 and a wife, Maria Allen (1804-1863), married about 1821, with children born 1822-28. One of them was Samuel A. 'Lemoreux', whose Iowa death record names Daniel as his father ([R4-S1]). The site and the Davenport genealogy give his wife as Martha Lum/Linn; FamilySearch attaches a Martha Linn death record to the John Lamoreux born 1754 instead.
sources: WikiTree Lamoreaux-21 (Thomas Lamoreaux; full will transcription citing FamilySearch images of Luzerne Will Book A): https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Lamoreaux-21 ; PAGenWeb will transcription: http://www.pagenweb.org/~luzerne/patk/tomlam.htm

Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport, Philipstown Pioneer 1682-1759, and his Descendants (1962): https://archive.org/details/thomasdavenportp00gile (also HathiTrust wu.89066038563: https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=wu.89066038563&view=1up&seq=395) pp.356-358
David Kendall Martin, The Eighteenth Century Lamoureux Family of the Hudson Valley (2008), pp.40-44
[R4-S1] FamilySearch published tree, Daniel Lamoreaux (LT7X-155), with attached index entries (derivative) https://www.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/persons/LT7X-155
